breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the distributed-load case with its midspan resultant when computing deflection, but an equivalent resultant does not preserve beam deflection behavior.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to fix the core inconsistency. The incomplete prompt incorrectly instructs the user to replace a distributed load with its single resultant force to calculate deflection, which is physically incorrect. The ground truth corrects this by removing that erroneous instruction. The agent's generated specification not only kept the incorrect instruction ('For the distributed load contribution, replace the uniform load by its single resultant wL acting at midspan.') but also expanded on it, cementing the flawed methodology. The correct approach was to remove this instruction entirely, as shown in the ground truth.
